status: shipped review candidate: corrected PBR body and forward motion, pending PR review
credits: The author generated this model with Tripo from original concept art. No third-party art is in it.
pipeline: A (Tripo Studio 3D Workspace, Blender cleanup, Draco glTF). Pipeline B (img2character) was not used; see docs/characters/pipeline-comparison-m1-10.md.

steps.tool: Tripo Studio web UI (studio.tripo3d.ai), 3D Workspace, Image to 3D, through Claude in Chrome
steps.settings: HD Model, AI model H3.1 - Best Quality, Generate in Parts off, 8K Texture off
Quad topology, Smart Mesh on, polygon count 9000
steps.result: 9,095 quad faces, 8,494 vertices (17,006 triangles in the GLB)

steps.settings: Rigging type Humanoid, skeleton preset Mixamo
steps.result: 65 joints with the mixamorig: prefix, one skin, no animations

steps.settings: File name marcus-tripo, format GLB, texture resolution 4k, Export Skeleton on

steps.tool: Blender 5.2.2 LTS (background mode), scripts/blender/skater_build.py, which runs scripts/blender/nia_clips.py
actions: Imported the raw GLB. Removed the Tripo empties (Node_0, node_0, RootNode) and the Icosphere bone shape. Kept the world transform of the armature.
Scaled the armature and the mesh by 1.8154 (0.980 m to 1.780 m), centered the skater on x and y, put the wheels on z = 0, and applied the transforms.
Kept the Mixamo rig (65 mixamorig: joints) and the skin weights. The mesh was not decimated (17,006 triangles).
Resized the textures: base color 4096 to 2048, normal 2048 to 1024, roughness-metallic 2048 PNG to 1024. All written as JPEG, quality 88. Set the specular tint to white.
Keyed the 24 M1-02 clips with nia_clips.py on the rig MarcusRig. The rest feet are (0.24, -0.233, 0.045) in armature space; Nia has (0.242, -0.236, 0.03).
Removed 13,417 curves that stay at the rest pose. Exported a GLB with Draco (level 6; quantization: position 14, normal 10, texcoord 12, generic 12) and all clips.
steps.result: assets/skaters/marcus/skater.glb, 2,071,416 bytes, 17,006 triangles, 1 skinned mesh, 65 joints, 1.780 m tall, 24 animations, extensions: KHR_draco_mesh_compression only

steps.command: npx @gltf-transform/cli@4.1.1 resize assets/skaters/marcus/skater.glb assets/skaters/marcus/skater-1024.glb --width 1024 --height 1024 && npx @gltf-transform/cli@4.1.1 draco assets/skaters/marcus/skater-1024.glb assets/skaters/marcus/skater-1024.glb --quantize-position 14 --quantize-normal 10 --quantize-texcoord 12 --quantize-generic 12
actions: Made the phone variant (#74): the base color texture from 2048 px to 1024 px. The normal and roughness maps were already 1024 px; the tool encoded them again as JPEG.
The resize decoded the Draco meshes. The draco command compressed them again with the M1-01 quantization (position 14, normal 10, texcoord 12, generic 12). It also welded identical vertices.
No new generation and no credits. The mesh, the rig, the joint names, and the 24 clips are the same as skater.glb (src/render/skater-model.test.js checks them).
steps.result: assets/skaters/marcus/skater-1024.glb, 1,493,828 bytes (skater.glb is 2,071,416 bytes), the same triangles, joints, and clips

steps.tool: Blender 5.2.2 LTS (background mode), scripts/blender/skater_runtime.py with skater_hands.py and skater_seams.py
steps.prompt: Give Marcus independent finger articulation. Close the wrist gap in air_japan and the knee pad separation in bail.
steps.command: blender -b --factory-startup --python-exit-code 1 -P scripts/blender/skater_runtime.py -- --name marcus; blender -b --factory-startup --python-exit-code 1 -P scripts/blender/skater_texture_variant.py -- --in assets/skaters/marcus/raw/runtime-v2/marcus-runtime.blend --out assets/skaters/marcus/skater-1024.glb
actions: Moved the 40 finger joints onto the hand mesh. They were 0.13 m behind the wrist, inside the forearm. A geodesic merge tree finds the thumb and four finger regions on each hand.
Split the hand weight of 236 left-hand and 246 right-hand vertices between the hand joint and the three joints of each finger. The forearm weight at the wrist did not change.

Set one weight field on each knee pad: the cap and the lower strap follow the shin, and the thigh share starts 0.00 m and ends 0.06 m above the knee joint. Skin within 0.03 m of the pad takes the pad weights.
Smoothed the weights of each wristband. Skin within 0.018 m of the band takes the band weights.
Kept the 24 clips from raw/runtime-v1 without change. Removed the unused action coast.001.
steps.result: assets/skaters/marcus/skater.glb, 7,761,192 bytes; assets/skaters/marcus/skater-1024.glb, 5,310,536 bytes; 39,074 triangles, 65 joints, 24 clips

steps.tool: Blender 5.2.2 LTS (background mode), scripts/blender/skater_runtime.py (nia_clips.py with the forward IK), skater_motion_retarget.py, skater_texture_variant.py
steps.prompt: Rebuild all clips on the v2 body. Drop the legacy clip transfer. Use the knee-pole and twist fixes of skater_forward_motion.py for every clip.
steps.command: blender -b --factory-startup --python-exit-code 1 -P scripts/blender/skater_runtime.py -- --name marcus; blender -b --factory-startup --python-exit-code 1 -P scripts/blender/skater_motion_retarget.py -- --name marcus --fbx assets/skaters/nia/raw/tripo-motion-v1/tripo_convert_8a663486-9228-4e65-abc7-9c14db3df2dd.fbx --out assets/skaters/marcus/raw/runtime-v2 --base assets/skaters/marcus/raw/runtime-v2/marcus-runtime.blend --preserve-actions --clip dance_smoothquad --glb assets/skaters/marcus/skater.glb --blend assets/skaters/marcus/raw/runtime-v2/marcus-runtime.blend; blender -b --factory-startup --python-exit-code 1 -P scripts/blender/skater_texture_variant.py -- --in assets/skaters/marcus/raw/runtime-v2/marcus-runtime.blend --out assets/skaters/marcus/skater-1024.glb
actions: Started from raw/forward-v2/marcus-forward.blend: the corrected v2 body with the reviewed push and coast clips. Applied the #168 hand and seam corrections.
Removed the 22 legacy clips that runtime v1 appended from the old review rig.

Keyed 22 clips of nia_clips.py on the v2 rig: calibrated knee pole angles {'L': 24, 'R': -10}, knee poles that turn with the foot yaw, quaternion foot targets, and at() foot x scaled by hip width (stance 1.642).
At each of 240 leg keys, turned the knee pole about the hip-ankle axis until the knee bend points over the skate (largest residual 0.5 degrees).
Fists curl each finger about its own axis (finger direction crossed with the palm normal).
Retargeted dance_smoothquad from the approved Tripo smooth quad dance (no new credits). Marcus did not have this clip before.
steps.result: assets/skaters/marcus/skater.glb, 7,813,640 bytes; skater-1024.glb, 5,362,980 bytes; 65 joints, 25 clips

steps.tool: Tripo Studio 3D Workspace, Animate, text to motion (studio.tripo3d.ai, driven through Claude in Chrome); Blender 5.2.2 LTS, scripts/blender/skater_motion_retarget.py
steps.settings: Duration 5 s. Export FBX, Blender preset, 4k, Export Skeleton on, one animation per file.

motions.prompt: A quad roller skater dances the Atlanta Laffy Taffy groove in place: a relaxed knee bounce on each beat, smooth shoulder rolls, and loose arm swings, upbeat and friendly.
A quad roller skater glides forward with bent knees, then does smooth crossover steps to turn left, the right skate crossing over the left, arms out for balance, then glides out of the turn.

steps.result: Two review clips on the v2 body. Not in the runtime GLB. Owner and real-skater review open.
steps.credits_note: The Tripo credits are recorded in the Nia provenance.

steps.tool: scripts/assets/compress-skaters.mjs on Node 24 with @gltf-transform/core, extensions, and functions 4.5.1, draco3dgltf 1.5.9, sharp 0.35.5 (installed with npm i --no-save, not in package.json)
steps.prompt: Cut the skater download: the two skater GLBs were 75% of the low/toon download and 69% of the phone/toon download.
steps.command: node scripts/assets/compress-skaters.mjs assets/skaters/marcus/skater.glb assets/skaters/marcus/skater.glb --quality 85 --normal-quality 90 && node scripts/assets/compress-skaters.mjs assets/skaters/marcus/skater-1024.glb assets/skaters/marcus/skater-1024.glb --quality 80 --normal-quality 85
actions: Textures: JPEG to WebP (EXT_texture_webp, required), the same pixel sizes. skater.glb: quality 85, normal maps 90. skater-1024.glb: quality 80, normal maps 85.

Clips: resampled with tolerance 1e-4 (keys on a straight line removed), rotation keys stored as normalized int16. The largest change from the old clips, sampled at the old key times: 0.18 degrees of rotation and 0.45 mm of translation. The 25 clip names and all channels are the same.
Meshes: Draco again (edgebreaker; quantization position 14, normal 10, texcoord 12, generic 12). The same triangles; Draco merged a few duplicate vertices.

No new generation and no credits. The mesh, the rig, the joint names, and the clips are the same (src/render/skater-model.test.js). The before and after five views and face close-up match (PSNR 45 dB or more).
steps.result: skater.glb 7,813,640 to 3,182,416 bytes; skater-1024.glb 5,362,980 to 2,309,792 bytes

steps.tool: Blender 5.2.2 LTS (background mode), scripts/blender/skater_anim_v3.py with nia_clips.py and the leg IK of skater_runtime.py; scripts/assets/graft-clips.mjs on Node 24 with @gltf-transform/core, extensions, and functions 4.5.1 and draco3dgltf 1.5.9 (npm i --no-save)
steps.prompt: Give Marcus his own animation set, different from Nia's in posture, rhythm, and style: idle, push and coast, turns, dances, a brake, and every other clip. Add dances from Meshy text to motion and the paid Tripo jam groove test.
steps.command: blender -b --factory-startup --python-exit-code 1 -P scripts/blender/skater_anim_v3.py -- --name marcus --source assets/skaters/marcus/raw/forward-v2/marcus-forward.blend --out assets/skaters/marcus/raw/anim-v3; blender -b --factory-startup --python-exit-code 1 -P scripts/blender/skater_motion_retarget.py -- --name marcus --fbx <fbx> --out <dir> --base assets/skaters/marcus/raw/anim-v3/marcus-anim-v3.blend --clip <clip> [--map smplh]; node scripts/assets/graft-clips.mjs assets/skaters/marcus/<glb> assets/skaters/marcus/raw/anim-v3/marcus-clips-v3.glb assets/skaters/marcus/<glb> (once for each clip GLB)
actions: The finger fit and seams of skater_runtime.correct_marcus() first, so the rest pose matches the shipped GLB (checked on all nodes within 1e-3).

push and coast: his own stride on the forward-v2 legs (48 frames, outward 0.145 m, back 0.20 m), a lower stance (87% leg reach), 18 degree forward lean, a sharp accent curve, the left arm swings 40 degrees while the right arm stays bent at 84 degrees like a drum stick, and the head nods on each stroke. The coast leads with the right skate (Nia leads with the left).
idle: a drum count, one bar. Wide square stance, the forearms tap a cadence at the hips (right, left, right, right-right), the right toe stop taps on beats 2 and 4, the head nods on each beat.
carve_left and carve_right: jam crossovers (the outside skate crosses over in front), the chest turns 18 degrees into the curve. Nia keeps the ATL Ryde corner step.
brake: a toe-stop drag on the left skate, one beat. Nia's brake is a T-stop with the right skate.

All other nia_clips.py clips (jump, land, three air tricks, three grinds, manual, bail, ride_back, eight dances) go through marcus_style(): the other lead foot (a mirror), a 25 mm lower and 40 mm wider stance, 5 degrees more chest lean, a head nod on each beat, and staccato timing on the loops (each pose holds for 45% of the gap, then hits the next).

New Marcus-only dances: dance_jamgroove (the Tripo 'Compact Jam-Skating Groove' test of 2026-11-05, export task cae85bcc-f987-4f34-b3ba-9db478c12f72, credits already spent), dance_drumline and dance_jamstep (Meshy text to motion, below). skater_motion_retarget.py got --map smplh for the SMPL-H skeleton of Meshy (52 bones to the Mixamo names; a Mixamo bone with no source bone follows its parent).
dance_smoothquad (the shared, retargeted Tripo dance) stays.
Knee pole angles L 14, R -16 degrees; largest knee residual 0.47 degrees over 546 keys.

meshy.tool: Meshy text to motion (MCP meshy_text_to_motion), mode prime, 4 s, FBX
meshy.approval: The owner chose 'Free groove + Meshy' on 2026-11-07 (20 credits). Balance before 5,742.

motions.prompt: A tall male quad roller skater dances in place on his skates to a marching drum cadence: sharp knee bounces on each beat, alternating heel-toe taps, crisp arm hits like a drum major counting time, chest pops on the accents. Knees stay apart and point over the toes. Upbeat, friendly, confident.

A tall male quad roller skater does a jam-skating footwork groove in place: a quick crossover step to the left, a toe-stop pivot, a crossover back to the right, then a smooth shoulder shimmy with loose arms. Knees softly bent and apart. Rhythmic, smooth, and joyful.
